# Set up transfer pricing and intercompany agreements

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before or when related entities transact across borders. Adviser-reviewed intercompany arrangements, pricing support and a calendar for reconciliations and local documentation.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)

## Outcomes

- Adviser-reviewed intercompany arrangements, pricing support and a calendar for reconciliations and local documentation.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Map related entities and actual transactions

agent-runnable


Inventory ownership, management, people, assets, IP, funding and services supplied between entities. Describe the actual work and cash flows rather than starting from a preferred tax outcome.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Determine local tax and documentation requirements

human · human approval required


Qualified advisers in the affected jurisdictions assess the transaction character, pricing approach and reporting obligations. Record the scope and unresolved issues; OECD guidance does not itself establish each country's filing rules.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare agreements and pricing support

agent-runnable


Document the proposed services, allocation keys, IP rights, financing terms and evidence supporting the pricing. Reconcile the agreements with operational behavior and flag unsupported assumptions for adviser review.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve agreements and accounting implementation

human · human approval required


Authorized entities review and execute the approved arrangements and establish invoicing, currency and payment controls. Keep legal authority, local tax treatment and bookkeeping implementation separately evidenced.

- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile transactions and reassess changes

agent-runnable


Compare intercompany invoices, settlements and balances with the approved model. Have advisers review material variances, new activities and local documentation updates before year-end adjustments are authorized.

- Verify: Adviser-reviewed intercompany arrangements, pricing support and a calendar for reconciliations and local documentation.
- Sources: [OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines](https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/publications/reports/2022/01/oecd-transfer-pricing-guidelines-for-multinational-enterprises-and-tax-administrations-2022_57104b3a/0e655865-en.pdf) · [GOV.UK structure your business overseas](https://www.business.gov.uk/export-from-uk/support-topics/routes-to-market-and-operating-overseas/structure-your-business-overseas/)
